meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Spatial statements, including RRBs, March 2004 to March 2017
meta.coverage: Deposits by type (current, savings, term) by state, bank group and population group (statement 3B), every quarter from March 2004 to March 2017, including regional rural banks
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1484 (data provider DP1), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Amounts in ₹ crore. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (Foreign banks, Rural, Rajasthan, population groups by the 2001 census, savings deposits on 2014-03-01; Foreign banks, Urban, West Bengal, population groups by the 2001 census, aggregate deposits on 2013-12-01; Foreign banks, Urban, West Bengal, population groups by the 2001 census, term deposits on 2013-12-01).
